question: Which rugby league legend became the first player in the sport's 130-year history to receive a knighthood, awarded by King Charles at Buckingham Palace in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ellery Hanley**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ellery Hanley** is a legendary figure in the world of rugby league and is widely regarded as one of the greatest players in the sport's history.
 
• In **2025**, Ellery Hanley became the first rugby league player to be knighted in the sport’s **130-year history**, a remarkable achievement that highlights his immense contributions to the game.
 
• The knighthood was conferred by **King Charles III** at **Buckingham Palace**, recognizing Hanley’s exceptional career and his impact on rugby league, both as a player and a coach.
 
• Throughout his career, Hanley played for prominent clubs such as **Wigan Warriors**, **Leeds Rhinos**, and **Balmain Tigers**, leaving an indelible mark with his skill, speed, and versatility on the field.
 
• He also captained the **Great Britain national team**, leading them to notable victories and earning a reputation as a true leader and ambassador for the sport.
